General workload/syscall allocation, canonical frame-slot publication, distribution applications/containers/VM hosting remain unqualified.
risk: High: actual memory ownership, pin/release transitions, source termination/resource and nonwrapping identity admission. Single-agent review with independent complete-state C oracles, complete firmware-map sweep, object/call/stack inspection and privileged VM observations; public publication gates remain closed.
